title: interpretation
description: Output of the policy interpreter (POST /rules/interpret). It is a DRAFT: nothing here is active and nothing here changes a stored policy. Semantic rules (byb_contracts.validate_interpretation): every proposed rule has status PROPOSED; a proposed rule carries a number only when the user's own words contained it (threshold_source USER_WORDS with the quoted span, origin USER_STATED), otherwise origin SYSTEM_PROPOSED with a null threshold; the interpreter never emits FICTIONAL_SCENARIO rules; ambiguous language produces a clarification, never a 'contradiction'.

model_id.description: Application model that produced the draft; null for a canned or template result.

words.description: The verbatim span that cannot be supported.

code.description: UNSUPPORTED_DEFINITION: e.g. 'oil producers' without a sourced classification. UNSUPPORTED_RULE_TYPE: no rule type measures this. OUT_OF_SCOPE: asks for advice, a forecast, a recommendation or a trade. INSTRUCTION_IGNORED: text that tries to instruct the system; treated as data.

about_words.description: The verbatim span that is ambiguous.

clarification_option.description: Choosing an option needs no second model call: a supported option carries the draft it leads to. proposed_rule (status PROPOSED) for a rule clarification; purchase_request for a purchase clarification; both null when the option needs more input or is unsupported.

supported.description: False for definitions we cannot evaluate yet; shown disabled with the reason in `description`.
